_comment: Canonical archaic-English -> modern normalization table for KJV verse matching. This file is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH consumed by BOTH sides of the semantic pipeline: the Rust query-side normalizer (semantic/normalize.rs, compiled in via include_str!) and the document-side export step (data/compute-embeddings.ts, read at export time). Both apply the same rule to whole ASCII-alphabetic words, case-insensitively, emitting the lowercase replacement. Keys MUST be lowercase. Editing this table changes the lexical space of BOTH the transcript and the pre-computed verse index, so the embeddings index MUST be regenerated after any change (npm run export:verses && npm run precompute:embeddings). Scope is deliberately narrow: pronouns, auxiliary/verb conjugations, and a couple of function words that KJV uses pervasively. A few entries (art->are, mine->my) are technically ambiguous outside scripture, but this app's transcript is church-service speech where the scripture-reading sense dominates, and because the SAME rule is applied to both sides, canonicalizing them still converges verse and transcript. Completeness is not required — partial normalization already narrows the gap and the embedding model handles the residue.
